strengths: One shell for every secondary module: settings and usage open in the same centered panel with a breadcrumb header, a close button and the same bordered card groups, so a non-chat screen feels native to the chat app.
Settings rows follow a single pattern (bold label, one-line muted description, control right-aligned) inside titled section cards; the whole page scans top to bottom without reading.
Numbers lead: usage shows '88% left' in large type first, with bars, reset countdowns and deltas as secondary detail. This is the right model for cash-flow and bills summaries.
Sidebar rows pack status into compact metadata (project tag, relative time, 'Waiting 28m', provider badge) while the title stays the dominant line.
The empty state is a direct question plus the composer, centered, so the next action is unmistakable.

issues.problem: The bar encoding has no legend: the white vertical marker, the hatched tail, two different hues per row and a gray Codex bar all carry meaning the user has to guess.
issues.fix: Label the marker (e.g. 'expected pace') and the hatched region, keep one hue per account, and add a small legend or tooltip on first use.

issues.problem: The floating top-right panel (user, Open in Zed, Add project script, branch) sits detached on an empty canvas and repeats the user and branch already shown under the composer.
issues.fix: Fold it into the composer footer or a header popover so context lives in one place next to the action it affects.

issues.problem: On a pure-black canvas the small gray descriptions and the off-state toggles have weak contrast; the off toggle almost disappears into the card.
issues.fix: Use a near-black base with slightly raised card surfaces, lift secondary text contrast, and give the off toggle a visible track border.

issues.problem: 'General' (selected) and 'Diffs & pull requests' (hovered) carry nearly identical fills, so the current page is not clearly distinguished; the last nav group (Maintenance, Labs, About, Archive) has no group header unlike the others.
issues.fix: Give the selected item a stronger fill or an accent bar, and either label the last group or separate it consistently.

issues.problem: Sidebar footer controls are icon-only and 'Settled 573 ›' is cryptic; the three top-right layout icons are also unlabeled.
issues.fix: Add text labels or always-available tooltips and a clearer name for the settled count.

issues.problem: 'Claude & GPT (shared) · Weekly' wraps to two lines and pushes its percentage down, breaking the left-column alignment every other card keeps.
issues.fix: Truncate or shorten the label, or widen the label column so all cards align on the same baseline.

strengths: Calm conversation layout: the user's message in a soft bubble on the right, the assistant's text unboxed at a comfortable line length, and tool work collapsed into a single 'Trabalhou por 8s ›' line.
The same shell carries non-chat modules: the image gallery keeps the icon rail, the page title style and the same composer, so a content grid and a chat read as one product.
Restraint: one neutral dark gray, almost no accent color, hierarchy carried by size and weight; nothing competes with the content.
Plain sectioned sidebar (Fixados, Projetos, Recentes) with quiet labels makes wayfinding simple even with a long history.
Per-message actions (copy, feedback, read aloud, more) sit as tiny muted icons under the reply, available without cluttering the text.

issues.problem: Sidebar titles are hard-clipped mid-word ('certidão do meu imó', 'verso', 'buscar e') with no ellipsis or fade, which looks broken in a list of thirty rows.
issues.fix: Apply an ellipsis or a fade mask at the edge and show the full title on hover.

issues.problem: The floating composer sits directly on the image grid with no scrim, covering the bottom of the third row and competing with the photos behind it.
issues.fix: Add a bottom gradient or solid dock behind the composer and bottom padding so the last row can scroll clear of it.

issues.problem: The left icon rail (seven icons) has no labels, and the right 'Resultados / Fontes' card has an unclear purpose with a very faint empty-state line.
issues.fix: Label the rail or show tooltips, and give the side card a one-line explanation and a visible call to action.

issues.problem: Captions on light images ('Esboço', 'Figurinhas') rely on a faint gradient, so legibility varies card by card.
issues.fix: Use a stronger, consistent scrim or place the caption below the image.

issues.problem: The thread sidebar disappears on the gallery while it is present in the conversation, so the navigation model changes between modules.
issues.fix: Keep the same navigation chrome across modules, or make the collapse an explicit, consistent toggle.

issues.problem: The composer placeholder and the disabled send button are very low contrast against the input surface.
issues.fix: Raise placeholder and disabled-icon contrast to at least 3:1 for the control.

strengths: Progressive disclosure of agent work: each batch of tool calls collapses to one muted summary line ('Usou Claude Docs 6 vezes ▸') that can be expanded, so the transcript stays readable.
A context side panel of key/value rows (Ambiente, Contexto with an 85% meter, Conectores, Saídas) gives glanceable state without leaving the conversation.
Typographic voice: serif for the assistant's prose and sans for interface chrome clearly separates content from controls.
Outputs are first-class objects: listed under 'Saídas' and linked inline, opening in a panel beside the chat instead of replacing it.
Collapsible project groups in the sidebar keep a long thread list manageable.

issues.problem: A raw '<artifact-view-context>' JSON payload is rendered inside a user message bubble; internal plumbing leaks into the conversation.
issues.fix: Hide machine-attached context or render it as a compact chip such as 'Viewing decisoes-do-port'.

issues.problem: The artifact pane takes about a third of the width to show only 'Este artefato foi excluído ou não está mais disponível', with no way forward.
issues.fix: Auto-collapse the pane for a missing artifact, or offer actions (close, open another output, recreate).

issues.problem: Four columns at once (sidebar, chat, info panel, artifact) squeeze the conversation into a narrow column and make the screen feel crowded.
issues.fix: Make the info panel and the artifact pane share one slot with tabs, or let one collapse automatically when the other opens.

issues.problem: The scroll-to-bottom button lands on top of message text with no backdrop.
issues.fix: Give it a solid surface and shadow, or anchor it just above the composer.

issues.problem: Six icon-only buttons in the header and tiny disclosure triangles on sidebar groups (MATCH, transform-it, WAY) give weak affordance.
issues.fix: Add tooltips or labels and larger, clearer disclosure targets.

strengths: Hierarchy through restraint: one large title, muted metadata, and color only where it means something (yellow status icon, green/red diff counts, the star).
The activity timeline uses two weights: system events as single muted lines, human comments as bordered cards, so importance is visible before reading.
The agent lives in a contextual panel attached to the work object, and its result is a structured card (Changed 2 files +22 −10, Draft PR, branch) rather than a paragraph.
Precise alignment and a consistent border, radius and spacing scale across sidebar, header, cards and panel; keyboard-style navigation (1/84 with up and down arrows) signals speed.
Sidebar sections (Workspace, Favorites) with small distinct icons scan quickly without heavy color.

issues.problem: The agent panel floats over the activity column: comment cards and the Reviews area are cut off underneath, so the user cannot read the thread and the agent side by side.
issues.fix: Dock the panel as a resizable side pane that pushes content, or narrow the activity column when it opens.

issues.problem: Small gray metadata (timestamps, 'connected by', system events) is low contrast on the dark surface.
issues.fix: Lift the muted text token one step while keeping it below body text.

issues.problem: The header action row (link, copy, branch, assign, dropdown) is icon-only.
issues.fix: Provide tooltips with shortcut hints or a labeled overflow menu.

issues.problem: The agent panel leaves a large empty gap between the diff card and the reply box.
issues.fix: Let the panel height fit its content, or anchor the composer closer to the last message.

overall: All four share the same backbone: a neutral near-black palette with almost no accent color, hierarchy carried by type size and weight instead of decoration, a persistent left sidebar with plain grouped sections, one composer pattern reused wherever the user can act, and secondary screens (settings, usage, gallery, side panels) built from the same shell, borders and spacing so every module feels like the same product. They hide machine work behind one-line summaries and surface results as structured cards or big numbers. For The Chatbot's non-chat modules (todos, notes, artifacts, cash flow, bills), the transferable recipe is T3's settings rows and usage 'big number first' cards plus Linear's two-weight timeline and structured result cards. What not to copy: unlabeled icon-only controls, low-contrast gray secondary text and panels that cover content. Every reference shown is dark mode only, so light-mode quality must come from the same token structure rather than from these screens.
